reason: Adds only static historical formation/form-up/strategy name lookup tables (Faction.HISTORICAL_FORMATIONS, HISTORICAL_FORM_UP, FACTION_STRATEGIES) and their display-name helper functions. Nothing draws or reads a battle side's Faction.Type at runtime yet -- Battle.gd only consumes FACTION_ROSTERS' flavor names at prebattle roster-selection time, before a unit is even spawned -- so there is no render path for a recorded battle to show. Wiring these into HUD.gd's formation label/menu once a side's faction is tracked at runtime is a separate follow-up.
